objective: Transfer observation-only temporal correspondence trained on navigation streams to a delayed-choice cue-recovery task with more deletions and distractor insertions

training.model_pseudo_selection: unsupervised fixed-eight marginal over five candidate streams
training.delayed_response_mapping: separately fitted from public delayed-choice train/0..299, validation train/5000..5059; no delayed temporal training

generator.true_cue: delayed simulator's opening public cue used by benchmark generator ONLY
generator.streams: one sensor sequence and five candidate forecasts; one correct cue and four distractors with duplicate decoy allowed; channels encoded with same hidden seed permutation
generator.sensor_noise: drop uniform 0..3 events, then insert uniform 2..4 random sensor tokens
generator.forecast_noise: drop uniform 0..2 events, then insert uniform 2..4 random forecast tokens
generator.cue_offset: candidate carries public proposal label [cue,0]; source name is synthetic

evaluated_methods: frozen variable-event model trained navigation only
metrics: actual delayed-choice task completion out of 40 with same train-fitted response mapping
count MAE for variable model vs always-6 and mean length minus 4
boundaries: No delayed test cue or correct action passed to scoring model, only benchmark generator/score
No delayed test data changes parameters
Known templates, four symbol channels and candidate-provided cue labels are engineered
No claim of independent blind cohort or general world transfer
Do not modify protocol, candidates or hyperparameters after first result
No OS actions, identity or consented memory data, automatic promotion
